title: Test launcher: a focused cargo run that executes zero tests reports PASS
outcome: Found 2026-09-25 (run test-9ec0ce39 in worktree TermAl-wt-ncc6-backend). A focused 'test-rust.sh --bin termal -- tests::test_runs::' run printed PASS with 'test result: ok. 0 passed; 2723 filtered out'. The filter matched nothing because cargo ran another worktree's binary: CARGO_TARGET_DIR pointed at TermAl-wt-engram-ready/target, and cargo judged freshness from that worktree's dep-info ('Finished in 2.96s', no 'Compiling termal'), so it never rebuilt the snapshot's sources. The evidence was invalid but reported as a pass. Fix direction: for focused cargo test stages, parse libtest's 'test result:' totals and fail (or at least warn loudly) when zero tests executed; document in docs/test.md that sharing CARGO_TARGET_DIR across worktrees can run a binary built from the other worktree's sources. Related: the launcher's fingerprint protects the source tree, not which binary cargo runs.
